title: Monsoon Chicken Fettuccine
description: A creamy, flavorful pasta dish featuring chicken and monsoon cheese, inspired by Italian cuisine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tbsp of butter over medium heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp of butter. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in monsoon cheese until melted and smooth. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Add cooked fettuccine to the skillet and toss with cheese sauce until well combined. If needed, add some reserved pasta water to achieve a creamy consistency.
Return chicken to the skillet and toss everything together until coated in cheese sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with additional monsoon cheese if desired.
